body.name: labelCausal
body.def: At \(p_0\), freeze the truth of every assertion inequality having nonzero base slack. For zero-base inequalities, evaluate their active directional pieces along \(Bu\), identify raw patterns with identical completed tangent regions, retain the lexicographically least representative of each equivalence class, and call the resulting finite set \(V\). The map \(\Lambda\) assigns equality to every incident weak pattern. It is a semantic map on endpoint assertions, not an evaluation of the generally unlawful vector \(p_0+Bu\).
